name: Pecos Watershed Conservation Initiative
summary: Annual grants to restore rivers, streams and Chihuahuan Desert grasslands in the Pecos watershed of southeastern New Mexico and West Texas, covering habitat restoration, species intervention and species information work.

geography.label: Pecos watershed, New Mexico and West Texas

amount.note: Larger requests are considered case by case.

reporting: Grantees report on metrics they choose from the programme's list in NFWF's Easygrants system.

status.quote: is announcing the tenth annual funding opportunity of the Pecos Watershed Conservation Initiative.

deadline.quote: 11/12/2026 Pecos Watershed Conservation Initiative 2027 Request for Proposals

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include: local, state, federal, and tribal governments and agencies (e.g., townships, cities, boroughs), special districts (e.g., conservation districts, planning districts, utility districts), non-profit 501(c) organizations, educational institutions.

geography.quote: The Initiative will award grants in southeastern New Mexico and west Texas within the Trans-Pecos Focal Area

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

window.quote: is announcing the tenth annual funding opportunity of the Pecos Watershed Conservation Initiative.

amount.quote: Grant requests should be between $100,000 and $500,000, with larger grant requests being considered on a case-by-case basis.

co_finance_required.quote: Applicants are required to provide $1 in matching funds for every $1 of NFWF grant funds requested.

reporting.quote: has a list of metrics in Easygrants to choose from for future reporting
